name: Dis
source:
Deacon of the Dark Church, a judge of death who judges wandering souls.
After exposing the deceased's crimes he leads the evil souls who hold sin to Hades.
Contrary to his appearance he's very compassionate, he holds a kindness that is very un-Shinigami-like.
Eve often takes advantage of that to manipulate him.
